lead.event: MSCI consults on reclassifying Indonesia’s stock market
lead.headline: MSCI consults on Indonesia reclassification amid risks flagged through April 2027
lead.blurb: The index provider is seeking views on a possible shift of Indonesia’s market from emerging to standalone status. Manulife Aset Manajemen Indonesia senior portfolio manager Rizki Ardhi called the period through April 2027 one of the domestic market’s most important moments, citing potential selling pressure from passive and active funds if foreign ownership changes. He said MSCI’s concerns center on market governance, despite reforms including higher free float and greater ownership transparency. Rizki urged regulators to keep communicating with MSCI and provide verifiable evidence of improvements.

market_structure_policy.event: OJK sanctions 10 capital-market violation cases and orders illicit gains returned
market_structure_policy.headline: OJK sanctions 10 capital-market cases, orders Rp23.77 billion returned
market_structure_policy.blurb: The cases include stock manipulation involving HOMI, SAMF and SMDM, with Rp3.71 billion in administrative fines. OJK also imposed 3-to-10-year capital-market activity bans on several individuals and ordered 15 securities accounts linked to the HOMI manipulation closed.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Rakyat Indonesia targets 20% ROE by 2028
earnings_guidance.headline: BBRI targets around 20% ROE by 2028
earnings_guidance.blurb: BRI plans to revive Kupedes micro lending, optimize capital and sustain dividends, with a short-term ROE target of 17%-18%. Management considers a payout ratio of around 60% sustainable and targets a stable dividend per share for fiscal 2026.

earnings_guidance.event: Merdeka Gold Resources reports nine-month loss amid Pani mine production ramp-up
earnings_guidance.headline: EMAS reports Rp339.6 billion nine-month loss as Pani ramps up production
earnings_guidance.blurb: Its 2027 production outlook is 165,000-180,000 ounces. Pani produced 26,331 ounces in Q3, up 69% quarter on quarter, while nine-month output reached 43,743 ounces; Merdeka Gold Resources attributed the loss to timing differences between production and sales recognition and tax expenses.

capital_raising_buybacks.headline: SMGR plans Rp250 billion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Semen Indonesia will fund the repurchase from internal cash, not IPO proceeds or debt, and limit it to 20% of placed and paid-up capital. The program will begin no later than three months after the announcement.
